newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans fall.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close lower as soybeans fall.

text.p: Sharply lower soybean futures pressured CBOT soy product futures to a lower close, traders said.
Heavier than expected deliveries posted Thursday on the November soybean contract hit the market as did an improvement in harvest weather in the U.S. Midwest.
Fund and technical selling led the way down with Refco Inc a key late seller of 600 lots of soymeal, traders said.
Soyoil futures volume was estimated at 15,000 contracts, up from 13,535 Wednesday. Soymeal futures volume was estimated at 28,000 contracts, up from 21,306 Wednesday.
Soyoil was 0.30 to 0.39 cent per lb lower, with December down 0.35 at 22.59. Soymeal was $3.00 to $8.20 per ton lower, with December down $7.10 at $219.50.
